paite: Nou leng na tatlekna uleh na khelhnate uh ziak a si na hih lai un ahon hihhing hi.
heading: Sihna A Pan Hinna
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

paite: Huaite ah tuma lam in hiai khovel dan bang in, huihkhua a thuneipa, tua thumang lou tate sung a semlelpa kha deihdan in na khosa uhi.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience;

paite: Huai thumang lou tate lak ah eite leng tuma lam in sa duhgawlna hih in, i tak taksa utnate bang in i om vek ua, midangte mah bang in thangpaihna ta a piang i na hi uhi.
english: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

paite: Himahleh zahngaihna hau Pathian in, itna thupitak a hon it ziak in,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

paite: tatleknate ziak a si i hih lai in Khrist toh ahon hihhing a, hehpihna a hotdam na hita uhi.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved),

paite: Khrist Jesu ah amah toh ahon kaithou a, van munte ah amah kiang ah ahon tukhawmsak hi.
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

paite: Huchi a hun hong tung dingte a, Khrist Jesu a i tung a migitna nei a, ahehpihna hauhdan a-etsak theihna ding in.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

paite: Hehpihna ziak a ginna tawn a hotdam na hi uhi; huai leng noumau a suak ahi kei a, Pathian thilthawnpiak ahi.
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

paite: Thilhih ziak ahi kei, huchi hi keileh mi'n asuang kha ding hi.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

paite: Thil hoih hih ding a Khrist Jesu a siam a om in, ama khutsuak i hi uhi; huai thil hoih hih i khosakna dan ding in Pathian in abawlkhol ahi.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

paite: Huaiziak in tuma lam a nou taksa a Zentelte, taksa khut a zeksum, achihte un zeksum louh hon chihte uh na hi uhi.
heading: Khrist A Khat Suak
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision,” (in the flesh, made by hands);

paite: Huai lai in, Khrist lou in Israelte khua-le-tui toh kimidang in khovel ah lametna nei lou leh Pathian lou a om in, thuchiam thukhun lak ah mikhual in na om uh chih theigige un.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

paite: Tu'n bel, Khrist Jesu ah nou nidanglai a gamlapi a omte, Khrist sisan a hihnai in na hong omta uhi.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

paite: Amah i kilemna ahi; ama'n ei nihte khat a siam in i kikal a kimelmakna baang lai ahihchimta hi.
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of partition,

paite: Thusehte leh dan thupiakte asa a hihmang in; huchi a nihte amah a mihing thak khat a siam a kilemna abawltheihna ding in.
english: having abolished in the flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace;

paite: Huan kros ziak a nihte pumpi khat a Pathian toh hon kilemsakna ding in kimelmakna ahihbeita hi.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility thereby.

paite: Huan amah ahong pai in, nou gamlapi a omte kiang ah leh naichik a omte kiang ah leng lemna tanchinhoih ahilh sam hi.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

paite: Amah ziak in kha khat a Pa kiang luttheihna i nei tuaktuak uhi.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

paite: Huchi in tu'n zaw, zin-le-leng na hi nawnta kei ua, misiangthoute toh tualsung khat leh Pathian inkuanpihte na hita uhi.
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

paite: Khrist Jesu ngei aning a suang kiphamohpen hi in, sawltakte leh zawlneite suangphum tung a lam na hi ua,
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

paite: amah ah suanglep tuam chiat kituaktak a suktuah, Toupa ah tempul siangthou asuak hi.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

paite: Amah ngei ah nou leng, Kha a Pathian tenna ding a lepkhawm na hi uhi.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
